findings.issue: rewriteHookPaths() uses fragile regex-based quoting that can break with edge-case command patterns. The opening/closing quote logic is split across two separate operations.
findings.recommendation: Simplify: extract relative path via match(), join with absoluteScriptsDir, wrap entire path in quotes in one operation.

findings.issue: CLI cache command uses bare JSON.parse() on AI-provided input instead of safeJsonParse pattern used everywhere else in the codebase.
findings.recommendation: Validate parsed JSON with hasDangerousKeys() or use safeJsonParse equivalent.

findings.issue: WOGI_WORKSPACE_ROOT env var used as filesystem write path without any validation (path.isAbsolute, existence check). The stop.js hook validates its env vars but this code does not.
findings.recommendation: Add validation: path.isAbsolute(workspaceRoot) && fs.existsSync(workspaceRoot) before using as base dir.

findings.issue: Schema drift: task-complete message format documented in workspace.js (lines 722-731) does not include verified, evidenceTier, and timestamp fields that task-completed.js actually writes. Manager agent reads docs as authoritative.
findings.recommendation: Update the documented message format in workspace.js to include the new fields.

findings.issue: discoverMcpServers() duplicates MCP settings-reading logic from flow-plugin-registry.js with a behavioral divergence (also reads ~/.claude/settings.json which the registry doesn't).
findings.recommendation: Extract shared MCP server discovery into a utility function. Not urgent — design divergence is intentional (capabilities needs user-level, registry doesn't).

findings.issue: tool.name and tool.description from cached data are embedded in prompt fragments without length limits or content sanitization.
findings.recommendation: Add length limits (name: 100, description: 200) when caching, strip backticks before prompt embedding.

findings.issue: changedFiles paths from input are embedded in message body without sanitization or length limiting.
findings.recommendation: Limit to first 20 files, cap path length to 200 chars, strip newlines.
